li.label: metallic awakening
li.description: A faint prickling beneath the skin. The nanomachines are beginning their work. This is just the start of something greater.

li.label: living metal integration
li.description: I can feel the metal threading through my veins, replacing the fragile with the eternal. Each pulse is progress.

li.label: biomechanical transcendence
li.description: My flesh yields to living metal. The machines are making me stronger, harder. I am becoming something beyond mere biology.

li.label: ascension to metal
li.description: Nearly complete. Soon there will be nothing left of this weak flesh. I will be perfect. Eternal. Machine.
